review_candidates.description: The P&C Programme Executive is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, monitoring and delivery integration of the asset renewal programme. The role assists in the development and maintenance of programme schedules, coordination of project activities, management of project interfaces, tracking of programme performance, and facilitation of stakeholder engagement to ensure successful delivery of asset renewal projects. The incumbent serves as the PMO's central coordinator for programme execution activities and works closely with Project Leads, asset owners, operations, engineering and support functions to ensure projects remain aligned with approved plans, milestones and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. Programme Planning and Scheduling Support the development and maintenance of the programme master schedule. Consolidate project schedules into an integrated programme plan. Monitor project milestones, deliverables and critical activities. Track schedule performance and identify emerging delays. Assist in updating programme timelines and delivery roadmaps. Support annual work planning and programme prioritisation exercises. 2. Programme Coordination Coordinate programme activities across multiple projects and stakeholders. Facilitate communication between Project Leads, asset owners and support departments. Organise and support programme delivery meetings and coordination sessions. Track project dependencies and interface requirements. Follow up on project actions and ensure timely closure. Assist in resolving programme coordination issues. 3. Project Progress Monitoring Collect and consolidate project progress updates from Project Leads. Monitor project delivery against approved milestones and schedules. Track project completion status and key performance indicators. Identify potential schedule risks and delivery bottlenecks. Escalate significant deviations to the Programme Manager (P&C). Prepare programme performance summaries and delivery dashboards. 4. Stakeholder and Interface Management Coordinate engagements between project teams and operational stakeholders. Support discussions relating to possessions, access arrangements and operational constraints. Facilitate interface coordination between engineering, maintenance, operations and contractors. Ensure stakeholder requirements are incorporated into project planning activities. Track interface issues and support timely resolution. 5. Resource Planning Support Monitor programme resource requirements and utilisation. Consolidate manpower and contractor deployment plans from projects. Identify resource conflicts and shortages. Support programme-level resource balancing and optimisation e􀆯orts. Maintain programme resource tracking records. 6. Risk and Issue Tracking Maintain programme delivery risk and issue registers. Monitor status of mitigation and corrective actions. Track project risks with potential programme-wide implications. Coordinate periodic risk reviews and update reports. Escalate unresolved issues affecting programme delivery. 7. Change and Dependency Management Track project changes affecting programme schedules and milestones. Assess impacts of proposed changes on project interfaces and dependencies. Maintain dependency registers and programme integration records. Support implementation and communication of approved changes. Ensure impacts are reflected in programme plans and schedules. 8. Reporting and Performance Management Prepare programme delivery reports and management dashboards. Consolidate project metrics relating to schedule, resources and delivery performance. Generate reports for management reviews and programme governance meetings. Maintain programme databases and performance tracking tools. Support preparation of presentations and executive updates. 9. Continuous Improvement Support the implementation of programme management standards and best practices. Identify opportunities to improve planning and coordination processes. Participate in lessons learnt reviews and post-project evaluations. Contribute to development of PMO methodologies and templates. Qualifications and Experience Min. Degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Business Administration or related discipline. 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, PMO or infrastructure delivery environments.
